title: Slovenské štátne sviatky (multijazyčné, openpotato/OpenHolidays)
description: Public holidays of the Slovak Republic as published by the OpenHolidays API and seeded from the openpotato/openholidaysapi.data monorepo.  Each record carries a stable UUID identifier, ISO start/end dates, RegionalScope (National vs Regional), and parallel names in Slovak (default), German, and English.  Complements the existing canonical-pin sk-statne-sviatky (vacanza algorithmic, SK/EN/UK, 1993-2030) by exposing the OpenHolidays seed snapshot (SK/DE/EN, 2020-2030, annual upstream curation).  Useful for OpenHolidays-API-compatible consumers and for cross-checking the vacanza algorithmic output against the OpenHolidays editorial source.
